title: how ilyas learned kurdish turkish arabic
source_text:
Məǧġə́l ʕal áydarbo yalifat ʕaraboyo ŭ kurdoyo!
U+kurdoyo. 
Aḥna bi+qriṯo me nǝʕmuṯayna, bә Kfarze, me nəʕmuṯayna qayimina bu+lešono, qayimina bu+lešono. 
Qamayto d̥kəmmínale lešono suryoyo emhoyo. 
Me emoṯayna, yalifina u+lešono suryoyo. 
Ŭ d̥ʔaḥna bi+qriṯayḏan, bi+qriṯayḏan dә Kfarze kətwa eba taqriban d... arbʕi+botè suryoye, ŭ kǝtwa šawʕi+tmoni+botè ṭaye.
Šawʕi+tmoni?
Šawʕi+tmoni+botè ṭaye.
Ema?
Bann+alfo ŭ čaʕmo... ŭ ḥamš+ŭ́+tmonì, alfo ŭ čaʕmo ŭ ḥamš+ŭ́+tmonì, alfo ŭ čaʕmo ŭ tǝšʕi, bann+əšnani kətwa qariwo mo, mo+ŭ+ʕesrì+ʕaylat.
Hat ema hawat?
Ono, alfo ŭ čaʕmo ŭ šwaʕ+ŭ+šawʕì. 
Šwaʕ+ŭ+šawʕì hawino bә Kfarze. 
Mәd̥... dínaqqa d̥koyoraw ḥa, d̥koqoyam ʕam ḥḏoḏe, aḥna mšiḥoye ŭ ṭaye, e, məqqa dəmmat u+lešono emhoyo lešono suryóyoyo, koyəlfínale bu+bayto, koyəlfínale ʕam aḥ+ḥawrone. 
U+lešono kurdoyo, kurdi koyəlfínale bu+šqoqo.
Aṭ+ṭaye bi+qriṯo kurdene aw ʕarabóyene? 
Kurd̥, ʕarab layt. 
Kurdne, kulle kurd̥, kurdoyo koməǧġoli, e. 
Aḥna koyəlfina mənne u+kurdi, bas hənnək lə+gyəlfi minan u+suryoyo. 
Kīt u+medano, yaʕni. 
Layt ḥa suryoyo ádyawma bi+qriṯo dlə+k̬ḏaʕ kurdoyo, layt ḥaste. 
Bas layto tloṯo+šaqṣat dmǝǧġoli lešono suryoyo bi+qriṯo maṭ+ṭaye, mak+kurdoye. 
Mawxa qayimina ʕam ḥḏoḏe bu+maktab, bu+šqoqo, baynә‿ḥḏoḏe ḥawrone, yalifina u+kurdoyo ġắlăbe ṭawwo. 
ʕAmánoste məqqa dəmmat azzano lu+maktab̥, azzán lu+maktab̥ du+tərki. 
Bu+tərkiste, ánnaqqa yalifina u+lešono turkoyo, lešono turkoyo d̥kətyo lešono di+dawle bu+maktab̥. 
E, u+talawәzyòn tə́rkiyo, u+maktab̥ tə́rkiyo. 
Kǝzzúx li+dàyĭra, lad+dàyĭrat, lar+rasmi, dáyĭrat di+dawle kulle tə́rkine. 
Bu+šqoqo falge du+ʕamo tərki koməǧġǝl. 
Mawxa yalifina támoste turkoyo.
Dínaqqa dәmšaylatli, dəmmat, ‘Áydarbo yalifat u+ʕàrabi?’ 
Ono bann+alfo ŭ čaʕmo ŭ šeṯ ŭ təšʕì azzino... Kito qriṯo qarútoyo l Mərde, əšma Bnebī́l. 
Tamo, moláfwayno lešono suryoyo. 
Moláfwayno tamo lan+naʕime di+qriṯo. 
Yaʕni malfono du+lešono suryoyo.
Suryoyo kṯobonoyo?
Kṯobonoyo. 
Tamo, fayǝšno taqriban lšato. 
Fayǝšno baynoṯayye dmolafli u+lešono suryoyo. 
Me tamo, man+noše d̥tamo, man+noše, man+naʕime, mi+ǧămaʕa, me kul+noše, yaləfno tamo ʕárabi. 
Bas ǧġaliye yalǝfno.
Ayko i+qrìṯoyo?
Qaruto l Mәrde, tmanyo+kilomatra. 
Qriṯo das+suryòyeyo. 
Mu+yawmo dyawme qriṯo das+suryòyeyo. 
Bas i+qriṯayo ádyawma fayəš d̥kətne mšiḥoye, bas ádyawma fayəš i+qriṯayo d̥kətne mšiḥoye tamo, bašqa layt.
Ayna lešono komәǧġoli?
Hani komәǧġoli lešono ʕárabi. 
Suryoyo lo+koməǧġoli? 
Lo, lo+kuḏʕi suryoyo, lo+kuḏʕi, ḥa mənne. 
Me tamo yaləfno mənne u+lešono, u+pratìk d̥koməǧġolínale ádyawma, hawxa ʕárabi. 
Bas dínaqqa dəmmat, u+ʕàrabi áydarbo ánnaqqa yalifat d̥qoratle? 
Tamo kətwa ḥoli, qášowa, ḥoli. 
Qášowa, u+kohno di+qrìṯowa, u+qašo di+qrìṯowa, dә Bnebī́l. 
Taqriban d̥ḥamši+əšne, tamo səmle kohnuṯo. 
Foyášwayno tamo gabayye bi+qriṯo, gab̥‿ḥoli, tamo yaləfno mine, moláfleli u+ʕàrabi, i+qraytayḏe. 
I+qrayto du+ʕàrabi, moláfleliyo, áydarbo g̊ʶqoreno u+ʕàrabi. 
Ŭ i+štaġaliye... <...> 
Mən qrelux b ʕaraboyo?
B ʕaraboyo qreli u+mgalī̀n, u+mgalī̀n ŭ hani, bi+qamayto u+mgalī̀n, ŭ bəṯr kṯowe ḥrene. 
Yaʕni, a+kṯowe ḥrene dǝmmina kito, dəmmina, qreli u+qurʔānste. 
U+qurʔānste?
U+qurʔānste qreli, hənna me di+tawra.
ʕAm ḥolux?
Lo, lo, eli lruḥi, eli lruḥi. 
Uʕdo ono bi+dukkanayḏi kǝtli qurʔā́n.
Qay?
Hawxa. 
Kobaʕno d̥fohamno mə‿kito tamo. 
Yaʕni, kobaʕno d̥fohamno bi+ṭayuṯo mə‿kito, yaʕni, i+ṭayuṯo mə‿komaḥko, yaʕni u+kṯowo mə‿komar, u+kṯowaṯṯe. 
U+kṯowo  di+ṭayuṯo, mə‿komar, u+kṯowo du+mgalī̀n mə‿komar.
Ŭ qrelux u+qurʔā̀n.
Kәtli uʕdo kṯowo du+qurʔā̀n bi+dukkanayḏi, ono bi+dukkanayḏi koqoreno u+qurʔā̀n naqqawoṯe. 
Ham bu+ʔàrabi...<...>
Ínaqqa d̥koweli zabno xalyo... <...> ínaqqa d̥koweno xalyo, yatiwo, dlə́kweli šuġlo, komōdno u+kṯowo, koqoreno. 
Koqoreno u+kṯowo ʕárabi, lăšan dmozadne, lăšan dmozadne hēš, yaʕni, u+ʕàrabi, dmaqwene. 
E, hani taqriban kibe ʕǝṣri, tarte ŭ ʕǝṣri+əšne, yaʕni, mi+naqlayo yaləfno, əšmo+əšmo koyolafno u+ʕàrabi. 
Hani ʕǝṣri+əšne yaʕni baynóṯeno, koqoreno.
Kul+yawmo?
Lo, lo kul+yawmo. 
Bi+šabṯo tarte, tlaṯ+kore. 
<...> ʕAmano, dəmmina, koqoreno ánnaqqa suryóyoste. 
Koqoreno kṯowe ġắlăbe suryóyeste.
Bas bʕaraboyo qrelux inǧī́l, ŭ qurʔā́n, ŭ bas?
Bas. 
Bas hiye... kṯowe du+ʕàrabi, layto harke ġắlăbe, a+kṯowe du+ʕàrabi, harke layt. 
Lə+k̬miqafən, yaʕni, a+kṯowe du+ʕàrabi. 
Mawxa, layto kul+kṯowo d̥qorat harke, yaʕni, laybux qorat kul+kṯowo harke, layto. 
Mawxa, koqorina maǧbū́r... hani a+kṯowànine d̥kətne bu+ʕàrabi, hánine, yaʕni, d̥ḥa kibe qoralle.

sentences.translation: In Arabic, I read the Gospels, the Gospels and these (sorts of things), at first the Gospels, and then other books.

sentences.translation: Like, the other books, let’s say, there are, let’s say, I read the Qur’an too.

sentences.translation: The Qur’an too?
I read the Qur’an too, some things from the Torah.

items.value: I read the Qur’an too, some things from the Torah.

sentences.translation: With your uncle?

sentences.source_line: Lo, lo, eli lruḥi, eli lruḥi.
sentences.translation: No, no, I did it by myself, I did it by myself.

sentences.translation: Now I, in my shop, I have a Qur’an.

items.value: Now I, in my shop, I have a Qur’an.

sentences.translation: Why?
So.
I want to understand what’s there.

items.value: I want to understand what’s there.

sentences.source_line: Yaʕni, kobaʕno d̥fohamno bi+ṭayuṯo mə‿kito, yaʕni, i+ṭayuṯo mə‿komaḥko, yaʕni u+kṯowo mə‿komar, u+kṯowaṯṯe.
sentences.translation: Like, I want to understand what’s there in Islam, like, Islam, what it says, like, what the book says, their book.

sentences.source_line: U+kṯowo  di+ṭayuṯo, mə‿komar, u+kṯowo du+mgalī̀n mə‿komar.
sentences.translation: The Muslim text, what it says, the Gospel text, what it says.

items.value: U+kṯowo  di+ṭayuṯo, mə‿komar, u+kṯowo du+mgalī̀n mə‿komar.

sentences.translation: And you read the Qur’an.

sentences.source_line: Kәtli uʕdo kṯowo du+qurʔā̀n bi+dukkanayḏi, ono bi+dukkanayḏi koqoreno u+qurʔā̀n naqqawoṯe.
sentences.translation: Now I have a text of the Qur’an in my shop, I’m in my shop, I read the Qur’an sometimes.

Now I have a text of the Qur’an in my shop, I’m in my shop, I read the Qur’an sometimes.

sentences.translation: Either in Arabic...

sentences.source_line: Ínaqqa d̥koweli zabno xalyo... <...> ínaqqa d̥koweno xalyo, yatiwo, dlə́kweli šuġlo, komōdno u+kṯowo, koqoreno.
sentences.translation: When I have free (lit. ‘empty’) time...  when I am free, sitting down, if I do not have work, I take the book, I read it.

items.value: Ínaqqa d̥koweli zabno xalyo... <...> ínaqqa d̥koweno xalyo, yatiwo, dlə́kweli šuġlo, komōdno u+kṯowo, koqoreno.
When I have free (lit. ‘empty’) time...  when I am free, sitting down, if I do not have work, I take the book, I read it.

sentences.source_line: Koqoreno u+kṯowo ʕárabi, lăšan dmozadne, lăšan dmozadne hēš, yaʕni, u+ʕàrabi, dmaqwene.
sentences.translation: I read Arabic writing, in order to improve it, in order to improve it more, that is, the Arabic, to strengthen it.

items.value: Koqoreno u+kṯowo ʕárabi, lăšan dmozadne, lăšan dmozadne hēš, yaʕni, u+ʕàrabi, dmaqwene.
I read Arabic writing, in order to improve it, in order to improve it more, that is, the Arabic, to strengthen it.

sentences.source_line: E, hani taqriban kibe ʕǝṣri, tarte ŭ ʕǝṣri+əšne, yaʕni, mi+naqlayo yaləfno, əšmo+əšmo koyolafno u+ʕàrabi.
sentences.translation: Yes, it’s been (lit. ‘it contains’) approximately these 20–22 years, like, from that time I (first) studied it, little by little I’m learning Arabic.

Yes, it’s been (lit. ‘it contains’) approximately these 20–22 years, like, from that time I (first) studied it, little by little I’m learning Arabic.

sentences.translation: These twenty years, like, I’m in the midst of it, I’ve been reading.

items.value: These twenty years, like, I’m in the midst of it, I’ve been reading.

sentences.translation: Every day?
No, not every day.
Two or three times a week.

items.value: Two or three times a week.

sentences.translation: On top of that (lit. ‘with that too’), let’s say, I now read Syriac too.

items.value: On top of that (lit. ‘with that too’), let’s say, I now read Syriac too.

sentences.translation: I read many Syriac books too.

items.value: I read many Syriac books too.

sentences.source_line: Bas bʕaraboyo qrelux inǧī́l, ŭ qurʔā́n, ŭ bas?
sentences.translation: But in Arabic, you have read only the Gospel, the Qur’an, and that’s all?

items.value: Bas bʕaraboyo qrelux inǧī́l, ŭ qurʔā́n, ŭ bas?

sentences.translation: That’s all.

sentences.source_line: Bas hiye... kṯowe du+ʕàrabi, layto harke ġắlăbe, a+kṯowe du+ʕàrabi, harke layt.
sentences.translation: But it’s... Arabic books, there aren’t many here, Arabic books, there aren’t any here.

But it’s... Arabic books, there aren’t many here, Arabic books, there aren’t any here.

sentences.translation: They aren’t to be found, like, Arabic books.

items.value: They aren’t to be found, like, Arabic books.

sentences.source_line: Mawxa, layto kul+kṯowo d̥qorat harke, yaʕni, laybux qorat kul+kṯowo harke, layto.
sentences.translation: Thus (lit. ‘from so’), every book you read isn’t here, that is, it’s not possible for you to read every book here, they aren’t there.

sentences.translation: Thus (lit. ‘from so’), (when) we read it’s necessary... these are these books that are in Arabic, they’re these ones, like, which someone could read.
